outro.tagline: From request to proposal, in one place.

video.name: quote

title.text: Request a quote in a minute

video.comment:
Buyer side: discover a coffee, request a quote (the roaster's console shows a web notification, captured and overlaid), receive the roaster's proposal, download the PDF (a real PDF, rasterised into a document card).

The `open-console` setup hook loads the supplier console in a background tab: it polls for quote requests and shows a web notification (Notification API) when ours arrives — the runner captures it (title, body, icon).

"A few hours later": the setup arms an automatic proposal for the NEXT quote request (POST /api/quotes/auto-proposal), stamped 4 h 18 min after the request. The shop loads notifications on page load only, so nothing shows until the `proposal` scene reopens the shop: the bell then rings with the new proposal — deterministic, no waiting, no polling.
